title: DNSSEC Validation Chain
description: A Mermaid tree diagram of the DNSSEC chain of trust from the root zone trust anchor down to a leaf A record, paired with the bottom-up steps a resolver performs to validate the chain.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Trace the DNSSEC chain of trust from the root zone trust anchor to a leaf record.
Explain how DS records link each zone to its parent and why any broken link causes a resolver to return SERVFAIL.

instructionalStrategies: Hover each zone top-down, then read the resolver steps to see validation runs bottom-up.
Trace where a single missing DS record would break the chain.

assessmentQuestions.question: Where does the chain of trust ultimately terminate, and how does the resolver know it can trust that point?
If bank.example rotates its KSK but the .example DS record is not updated, what does the resolver return and why?

chapter_title: "Advanced Network Defense: Wireless, DNS, and Zero Trust"
